name: Auto Signal
summary: Automatically space railway signals across a track section with a minimum distance.
description: Enable Auto Signal when placing a railway signal to rearrange all signals facing the same direction in the section. The signal you place may move. Placement stops at junctions, station boundaries and track ends. Set a minimum spacing from 50 to 2000 m. Signals facing the opposite direction are kept. Disable Auto Signal for ordinary single-signal placement. Do not enable Automatic Signal Spacing at the same time.

zh_CN.name: 自动铁路信号
zh_CN.summary: 按最小间距要求，自动均匀布置整段铁路的信号灯。
zh_CN.description: 放置信号灯时开启自动布置，即可重新布置本区段所有同向信号灯，刚放下的信号灯也可能移动。布置范围在岔道、车站边界和轨道末端停止。最小间距可设为50至2000米。反向信号灯保留。关闭自动布置后可照常放置单个信号灯。请勿同时启用Automatic Signal Spacing。
